coach_reasoning.death_heavy: You died {deaths} time(s) but only secured {kills} kill(s) in this round. Your positioning may have been too aggressive or exposed.
coach_reasoning.aggressive: Strong round! {kills} kill(s), no deaths. Your aim and engagement timing were sharp.
coach_reasoning.late_contact: First enemy contact at {time:.1f}s ({pct:.0f}% into round). This suggests passive play or slow map control.
coach_reasoning.early_contact: Enemy contact at {time:.1f}s -- very early. You may be rushing without utility support.
coach_reasoning.no_combat: No kills or deaths in a {duration:.0f}s round. You may have been too passive or isolated.
coach_reasoning.kd_improving: K/D improving: {early:.1f} early -> {late:.1f} late. You adapted well as the match progressed.
coach_reasoning.kd_declining: K/D declining: {early:.1f} early -> {late:.1f} late. Opponents may have adapted to your playstyle.
coach_reasoning.early_deaths: You died within the first 30 seconds in {count}/{total} rounds ({pct:.0f}%). Early deaths give the enemy team a significant advantage.
coach_reasoning.loss_streak: You had a {streak}-round losing streak. This may indicate tilt or opponents exploiting a pattern.
coach_reasoning.inconsistent: High round-to-round variance: kills range from {min} to {max} (avg {avg:.1f}). Your performance is inconsistent.
coach_reasoning.flash_episode: Continuous flash blindness lasted about {seconds:.1f}s here; this is linked to the exact moment.
coach_reasoning.scope_episode: This continuous scoped hold lasted about {seconds:.1f}s and may have limited peripheral information.
coach_reasoning.engagement_window: An opposing player was detected {time:.1f}s into this round, establishing a visual-evidence engagement review window.

coach_action.death_heavy: Hold angles from cover. Use utility (flash/smoke) before peeking common angles. Only peek when you have a clear advantage.
coach_action.aggressive: Keep up the crosshair placement. Review positioning after each kill -- do not over-extend.
coach_action.late_contact: Take map control earlier. Contest key areas with utility in the first 15-20 seconds.
coach_action.early_contact: Use flash/smoke before pushing. Coordinate with teammates for trade potential.
coach_action.no_combat: Communicate with teammates. Position for trades. If lurking, align timing with team executes.
coach_action.combat_density: Prioritise staying alive over chasing kills. Hold advantageous positions and let opponents make mistakes.
coach_action.kd_improving: Continue warming up before matches to start strong from round 1.
coach_action.kd_declining: Vary your approach between rounds. If you always peek the same angles, opponents will pre-aim them.
coach_action.early_deaths: Prioritise survival in the opening phase. Use safer pathing routes and check corners more carefully.
coach_action.loss_streak: After 2 consecutive lost rounds, take a mental reset. Change your positioning or try a new angle.
coach_action.inconsistent: Focus on consistency. Practice deathmatch for 10 minutes before competitive matches to stabilise aim.
coach_action.flash_exposure: Turn away from incoming flashes and use cover before re-peeking.
coach_action.scope_hold: Unscope periodically to refresh peripheral information and avoid holding one angle too long.
coach_action.engagement_review: Review about two seconds before and after this frame: check likely-head-height pre-aim, usable cover, and whether you could disengage or be traded after firing.
